claims.text: A 60-second apnea event was detected in recording c02 starting at 2000-01-05T05:40:00+00:00 and ending at 2000-01-05T05:41:00+00:00, corresponding to window index 340.

The detector flagged this window as an anomaly with a reconstruction error of 3.628, exceeding the threshold of 3.521 by a margin of 0.108 (normalized margin 0.031); these values are reconstruction threshold evidence and not probabilities or calibrated confidence.
The detector is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (model version apnea-05-c02_seed2026, fold apnea-05-c02) trained on the apnea dataset and evaluated on test patient c02.

No signal-level summary or attention-based explanation is available for this window; attention semantics indicate shared window-level temporal relevance, not channel-specific importance or causal evidence.
The current evidence supports an anomaly alert for the 60-second window in c02, based on reconstruction error exceeding the threshold, with no additional signal or attention explanation available.
